_rationale: An empty body vacuously satisfies the struct rule: 'body consists exclusively of field_decl-shaped lines with no calls.' Zero field declarations is still exclusively field declarations (no counterexample). This keeps `Empty:` and `struct Empty:` equivalent (ADR-008 — same AST for concise and explicit forms) and gives users a valid zero-field / unit-like type. The alternative (error, force explicit keyword) adds friction with no safety benefit since a zero-field struct is not dangerous. Decision recorded in DECISIONS.md Issue 1/2 note.
